brief: Runs a piece of Ring code once for each item of a list, binding the item's values to named loop variables.
detail: Build it with @ForEach(p, pIn), giving the variable name or names and the data as :In = ... Then Exec (or Run, X, @) takes the code as text and evaluates it once per item. With several names, each item of the list is a list and every name is a variable inside the code; with one name, read the item through v(:Name), because the name itself is not bound. ExecN runs the code only at chosen positions, and @SetIterations narrows every later Exec to a list of positions. The code is evaluated inside the object, so collect results in a global variable. A text can be walked with a single name, but byte by byte, and an empty list or text raises an index error when run.
